laws.rule: Poás Volcano: daily 8 am to 4 pm, entry by booking only. Non-resident adults US$15 (about A$21.31 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), children 2 to 12 US$5 (about A$7.10 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). No entry drunk or on drugs, no pets, no smoking (Law 9028), no leaving trails; there are no bins, so carry rubbish out. Follow ranger instructions because of volcanic activity.
